g.text: the infestation. where'd it come from?
COME OUT COME OUT WHEREVER YOU AAAARE hahahaaaaaa
Flare, whatever's going on, please. Stop.
Can... we talk about our conversation yesterday?
That's a question with a weird answer, but I'll do my best.
The last time we talked about this, you kinda freaked out. Are we going to be okay?
Because I'm getting sick of this shit.
Whatever's wrong, I can help you.
I wish we knew. We've tried to find answers.
yeah. sorry about that. shouldn't have jumped down your throat, it's just that this is... all a lot
Well! Funny thing You should ask about that...
well, pardon me while i just laugh my ass off for a moment
between the situation with the rippers and now...
Everything was just FINE with Us until YOU gave them HOPE
Who are you talking about when you say "we?"
It was going just wonderfully until YOU arrived into OUR lives
because You are just so sticky sweet, aren't You? We could just Eat You Right Up...
Um. Pretty sure we did, but maybe I'm wrong.
Uh... Yeah, we did. Check your chat logs.
titch overwhelming. i've always been... um... well, it's embarrassing, but i've always been the emotional type
HOPE that they might be FREE of US. Which will NEVER. EVER. HAPPEN. AND YOU KNOW IT
Goooood... then maybe We will get along after all...
Ssh... not what We are here for. We have a Question.
Ready to just BUGGER everything up
i'm sorry, you mean to tell me that clown entrati was running amok through *time* shooting people up with his little warframe serums turning them into sol-knows-what
and i'm still grieving the loss of my friends, i suppose
Not every Princess in a Castle wants to be Saved from their Dragon, isn't that right, mmmm?
Last I checked, I was here saving people.
I'm sorry? What did I do?
I get it. Not a problem.
Though some of Us are the Dragon, aren't we? Ahahahaaaaa
LEARN TO STAY OUT OF OTHER PEOPLE'S BUSINESS, SUGAR
back on topic. where'd the infestation come from?
Mmm. Did you know some cultures only have one word for both Demon and Dragon? Funny, that....
Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank2Convo2.
Well... the Orokin didn't *just* use the Infestation to make Warframes, they used it to make a bunch of other weaponry, too-
Who are You playing in OUR story, Sugar?
"no, flare, darling, they didn't just commit *one* warcrime with the poorly understood disease they farmed out of gods-know-where, they did *several,* you silly goose!"
i am getting such a migrane from all this
I've already lived through one storybook. I'm not interested in another.
so... is it from space? earth? the future? the past? do you know *anything?*
We know that it was a really effective weapon against the Sentients. But unfortunately, it tends to drive whatever biological life form it takes over insane over time.
We know it can communicate with other infested life forms as sort of a weird hive-mind type thing, but within certain strains. It's not very well understood.
OoOooOoh after Our Own Heart!! Villains are So Much More Juicy, aren't They?
No Choice is a Choice. Haven't You Learned that Yet?! APATHY IS A VOID THAT SCREAMS YOUR NAME.
Without all that Prickly MORALITY to get Stuck in Our Teeth... So from One Demon to Another...
but VERY WELL. IIIIF YOU don't want to answer Our question, so be it... Choose Your Own Path for now...
We will give You fair warning... This one BELONGS TO US. They are NOT YOURS.
But Hero Beware... This one belongs to US. They are not YOURS!!
We have Our own means of digging into Your Insides and chewing the marrow from Your bones yet...
yeah. i'm going to go need to doodle out some lyrics about this one. talk soon
Kisses, Sugar.... Ta Taaaa for now.... ;)
Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank2Convo2.
Quiet, Villain. Be Good For Us. Just Once.
Sssh Villain... You'll Learn. Soon Enough.
Silly Little Hero... You'll learn... You'll Learn Soon Enough...
Mmmmm.... We could get used to that.
Mmmmm.... We could get used to that.
Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank2Convo2.
